summary: Members who want a floor vote must first get the one person authorized to call it to act.
realLife: A House rule reserved the motion on a Senate funding measure to Eric Cantor or his designee during the 2013 shutdown.
inGame: needs: the floor rule naming the member or delegate who may call a particular bill.

turns.what: The authorized member designates a colleague to call the bill.
turns.pulledBy: The rule permits a delegate and the member will miss the sitting.
turns.writesBack: The delegate can make the motion.

turns.what: The authorized member waits until after a caucus meeting to make the motion.
turns.pulledBy: Members are still negotiating before the meeting.
turns.writesBack: The floor takes up the bill at a later sitting.
